# Complex Core Type Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define the sealed `Complex<T>` core type in `src/complex/mod.rs`, including the exact `ComplexFloat` public bound, the internal `Float` helper trait, the `#[repr(C)]` struct layout, the `PartialEq` / `Display` / `Sealed` implementations required by `Element`, and the constructor/accessor surface required by later arithmetic, formatting, math, and FFI tasks.

**Architecture:** `complex/` is an L1 module that depends only on `core` and `crate::private`. `Complex<T>` remains publicly generic but is sealed to `f32` and `f64` through `ComplexFloat: private::Sealed`. Floating-point-specific math stays in concrete `impl Complex<f32>` and `impl Complex<f64>` blocks so the internal `Float` trait never leaks into the public API.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `core` (`fmt`, arithmetic traits), sealed trait pattern via `crate::private`

**Design Docs:** `design/04-complex.md` §5.1, §5.2, §5.3, §5.4, §5.8, §5.9, §8.2, `design/03-element.md` §5.1, §5.7, `design/01-architecture.md` §1.3, §5.2, §11, `design/00-coding.md` §2, §4.2, §7.2, §8

**Prerequisites:** W1T4 (`src/private.rs`) must be complete.

        assert_eq!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f64>>(), 8);
    }

        assert_eq!(lhs, rhs);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_nan_neq() {
        let lhs = Complex::new(f32::NAN, 1.0);
        assert_ne!(lhs, lhs);

        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0)), "3+4j");

        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -0.0)), "3-0j");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_supported_types_are_sealed() {
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f32>>();
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f64>>();
    }
}

use crate::private;
use core::fmt::Debug;

pub trait ComplexFloat:
    private::Sealed
    + Copy
    + Default
    + Debug
    + PartialEq
    + PartialOrd
    + core::ops::Add<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Sub<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Mul<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Div<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Neg<Output = Self>
{
    fn abs(self) -> Self;
}

impl ComplexFloat for f32 {
    #[inline]
    fn abs(self) -> Self {
        self.abs()
    }
}

impl ComplexFloat for f64 {
    #[inline]
    fn abs(self) -> Self {
        self.abs()
    }
}

pub(crate) trait Float:
    Copy
    + Clone
    + Default
    + Debug
    + PartialEq
    + PartialOrd
    + core::ops::Add<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Sub<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Mul<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Div<Output = Self>
    + core::ops::Neg<Output = Self>
{
    fn zero() -> Self;
    fn one() -> Self;
    fn abs(self) -> Self;
    fn sqrt(self) -> Self;
    fn hypot(self, other: Self) -> Self;
    fn atan2(self, other: Self) -> Self;
    fn sin(self) -> Self;
    fn cos(self) -> Self;
    fn exp(self) -> Self;
    fn ln(self) -> Self;
    fn is_nan(self) -> bool;
    fn is_finite(self) -> bool;
}

impl Float for f32 {
    #[inline]
    fn zero() -> Self {
        0.0
    }

    #[inline]
    fn one() -> Self {
        1.0
    }

    #[inline]
    fn abs(self) -> Self {
        self.abs()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn sqrt(self) -> Self {
        self.sqrt()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn hypot(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        self.hypot(other)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn atan2(self, other: Self) -> Self {
        self.atan2(other)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn sin(self) -> Self {
        self.sin()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn cos(self) -> Self {
        self.cos()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn exp(self) -> Self {
        self.exp()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn ln(self) -> Self {
        self.ln()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn is_nan(self) -> bool {
        self.is_nan()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn is_finite(self) -> bool {
        self.is_finite()
    }
}

impl Float for f64 {
    #[inline]
    fn zero() -> Self {
        0.0
    }

    #[inline]
    fn one() -> Self {
        1.0
    }

    #[inline]
    fn abs(self) -> Self {
        self.abs()
    }

    #[inline]
    fn sqrt(self) -> Self {
        self.sqrt()
    }

    }

    }

    #[inline]
    fn is_finite(self) -> bool {
        self.is_finite()
    }
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Complex<T: ComplexFloat> {
    pub re: T,
    pub im: T,
}

impl<T: ComplexFloat> Complex<T> {
    #[inline]
    pub const fn new(re: T, im: T) -> Self {
        Self { re, im }
    }
}

impl private::Sealed for Complex<f32> {}
impl private::Sealed for Complex<f64> {}

impl<T: ComplexFloat> PartialEq for Complex<T> {
    #[inline]
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.re == other.re && self.im == other.im
    }
}

trait PositiveZero {
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool;
}

impl PositiveZero for f32 {
    #[inline]
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.to_bits() == 0.0f32.to_bits()
    }
}

impl PositiveZero for f64 {
    #[inline]
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.to_bits() == 0.0f64.to_bits()
    }
}

#[inline]
fn scalar_is_positive_zero<T: PositiveZero>(value: T) -> bool {
    value.is_positive_zero()
}

impl<T> core::fmt::Display for Complex<T>
where
    T: ComplexFloat + core::fmt::Display + PositiveZero,
{
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        if self.im != self.im {
            return write!(f, "{}+NaNj", self.re);
        }

        if self.im == T::default() {
            if scalar_is_positive_zero(self.im) {
                write!(f, "{}", self.re)
            } else {
                write!(f, "{}{}j", self.re, self.im)
            }
        } else if self.re == T::default() {
            write!(f, "{}j", self.im)
        } else if self.im > T::default() {
            write!(f, "{}+{}j", self.re, self.im)
        } else {
            write!(f, "{}{}j", self.re, self.im)
        }
    }
}

const _: () = {
    assert!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f32>>() == 8);
    assert!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f32>>() == 4);
    assert!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f64>>() == 16);
    assert!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f64>>() == 8);
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::private::Sealed;

    use super::Complex;

    fn assert_sealed<T: Sealed>() {}

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_layout_f32() {
        assert_eq!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f32>>(), 8);
        assert_eq!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f32>>(), 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_layout_f64() {
        assert_eq!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f64>>(), 16);
        assert_eq!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f64>>(), 8);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_eq() {
        let lhs = Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0);
        let rhs = Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0);
        assert_eq!(lhs, rhs);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_nan_neq() {
        let lhs = Complex::new(f32::NAN, 1.0);
        assert_ne!(lhs, lhs);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_display_format() {
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0)), "3+4j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -4.0)), "3-4j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -0.0)), "3-0j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(0.0_f32, 4.0)), "4j");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_supported_types_are_sealed() {
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f32>>();
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f64>>();
    }
}

        assert_ne!(lhs, lhs);

    fn test_complex_display_format() {
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0)), "3+4j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -4.0)), "3-4j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -0.0)), "3-0j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(0.0_f32, 4.0)), "4j");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_supported_types_are_sealed() {
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f32>>();
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f64>>();
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_imag() {
        let value = Complex::from_imag(2.5_f32);
        assert_eq!(value.re(), 0.0);
        assert_eq!(value.im(), 2.5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_conj() {
        let value = Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0).conj();
        assert_eq!(value, Complex::new(3.0, -4.0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_real_and_imaginary_queries() {
        assert!(Complex::new(3.0_f32, 0.0).is_real());
        assert!(Complex::new(0.0_f32, 4.0).is_imaginary());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_nan_and_finite_queries() {
        assert!(Complex::new(f32::NAN, 1.0).is_nan());
        assert!(Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0).is_finite());
    }
}

        Self { re, im }

    #[inline]
    pub fn from_imag(im: T) -> Self {
        Self::new(T::default(), im)
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn re(self) -> T {
        self.re
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn im(self) -> T {
        self.im
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn conj(self) -> Self {
        Self::new(self.re, -self.im)
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn is_real(self) -> bool {
        self.im == T::default()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn is_imaginary(self) -> bool {
        self.re == T::default()
    }
}

impl Complex<f32> {
    #[inline]
    pub fn is_nan(self) -> bool {
        self.re.is_nan() || self.im.is_nan()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn is_finite(self) -> bool {
        self.re.is_finite() && self.im.is_finite()
    }
}

impl Complex<f64> {
    #[inline]
    pub fn is_nan(self) -> bool {
        self.re.is_nan() || self.im.is_nan()
    }

    #[inline]
    pub fn is_finite(self) -> bool {
        self.re.is_finite() && self.im.is_finite()
    }
}

impl private::Sealed for Complex<f32> {}
impl private::Sealed for Complex<f64> {}

impl<T: ComplexFloat> PartialEq for Complex<T> {
    #[inline]
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
        self.re == other.re && self.im == other.im
    }
}

trait PositiveZero {
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool;
}

impl PositiveZero for f32 {
    #[inline]
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.to_bits() == 0.0f32.to_bits()
    }
}

impl PositiveZero for f64 {
    #[inline]
    fn is_positive_zero(self) -> bool {
        self.to_bits() == 0.0f64.to_bits()
    }
}

#[inline]
fn scalar_is_positive_zero<T: PositiveZero>(value: T) -> bool {
    value.is_positive_zero()
}

impl<T> core::fmt::Display for Complex<T>
where
    T: ComplexFloat + core::fmt::Display + PositiveZero,
{
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        if self.im != self.im {
            return write!(f, "{}+NaNj", self.re);
        }

        if self.im == T::default() {
            if scalar_is_positive_zero(self.im) {
                write!(f, "{}", self.re)
            } else {
                write!(f, "{}{}j", self.re, self.im)
            }
        } else if self.re == T::default() {
            write!(f, "{}j", self.im)
        } else if self.im > T::default() {
            write!(f, "{}+{}j", self.re, self.im)
        } else {
            write!(f, "{}{}j", self.re, self.im)
        }
    }
}

const _: () = {
    assert!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f32>>() == 8);
    assert!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f32>>() == 4);
    assert!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f64>>() == 16);
    assert!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f64>>() == 8);
};

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use crate::private::Sealed;

    use super::Complex;

    fn assert_sealed<T: Sealed>() {}

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_layout_f32() {
        assert_eq!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f32>>(), 8);
        assert_eq!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f32>>(), 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_layout_f64() {
        assert_eq!(core::mem::size_of::<Complex<f64>>(), 16);
        assert_eq!(core::mem::align_of::<Complex<f64>>(), 8);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_eq() {
        let lhs = Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0);
        let rhs = Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0);
        assert_eq!(lhs, rhs);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_nan_neq() {
        let lhs = Complex::new(f32::NAN, 1.0);
        assert_ne!(lhs, lhs);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_display_format() {
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0)), "3+4j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -4.0)), "3-4j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(3.0_f32, -0.0)), "3-0j");
        assert_eq!(format!("{}", Complex::new(0.0_f32, 4.0)), "4j");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_complex_supported_types_are_sealed() {
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f32>>();
        assert_sealed::<Complex<f64>>();
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_from_imag() {
        let value = Complex::from_imag(2.5_f32);
        assert_eq!(value.re(), 0.0);
        assert_eq!(value.im(), 2.5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_conj() {
        let value = Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0).conj();
        assert_eq!(value, Complex::new(3.0, -4.0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_real_and_imaginary_queries() {
        assert!(Complex::new(3.0_f32, 0.0).is_real());
        assert!(Complex::new(0.0_f32, 4.0).is_imaginary());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_nan_and_finite_queries() {
        assert!(Complex::new(f32::NAN, 1.0).is_nan());
        assert!(Complex::new(3.0_f32, 4.0).is_finite());
    }
}
